message.content:
### Building a New PC – Step‑by‑Step Guide

Below is a practical, beginner‑friendly walkthrough.  
Feel free to skip sections you already know, but keep the order for safety and best results.

| # | What to Do | Why It Matters | Tips |
|---|------------|----------------|------|
| 1 | **Plan & Budget** | Know what you’ll use it for (gaming, video editing, office, etc.) | List components, compare prices, set a realistic budget. |
| 2 | **Gather Tools & Workspace** | Clean, static‑free area | 1‑hand screwdriver, anti‑static wrist strap (optional), microfiber cloth. |
| 3 | **Choose a Case** | Determines airflow, size, aesthetics | ATX, Micro‑ATX, Mini‑ITX; check GPU & PSU clearance. |
| 4 | **Pick a Power Supply (PSU)** | Supplies power to all parts | 80+ Bronze or better, enough wattage (e.g., 650W for mid‑range). |
| 5 | **Select a Motherboard** | Connects CPU, RAM, storage, expansion | Match socket to CPU (Intel LGA1200, AMD AM4, etc.), check form factor. |
| 6 | **Choose a CPU** | Core performance | Intel i5/i7/i9, AMD Ryzen 5/7/9. |
| 7 | **Get RAM** | Speed & capacity | DDR4/DDR5, 16GB minimum for gaming, 32GB+ for content creation. |
| 8 | **Pick Storage** | SSD for speed, HDD for bulk | NVMe M.2 SSD (500GB–1TB) + optional SATA HDD. |
| 9 | **Select a GPU** | Graphics performance | NVIDIA RTX 3060/3070, AMD RX 6700 XT, etc. |
|10 | **Add Cooling** | Keeps components safe | Stock cooler (often comes with CPU) or aftermarket air/ AIO liquid cooler. |
|11 | **Install the PSU** | First step inside case | Slide into case, secure screws, route cables. |
|12 | **Mount the Motherboard** | Foundation for everything | Align standoffs, screw in, leave space for GPU. |
|13 | **Install the CPU** | Core of the system | Open socket, align pin/land pattern, gently place, lock. |
|14 | **Apply Thermal Paste & Install Cooler** | Heat transfer | Use pea‑size amount, attach cooler, secure. |
|15 | **Insert RAM** | Memory slots | Snap in, ensure proper orientation. |
|16 | **Mount Storage** | SSD/HDD placement | Secure M.2 in slot, SATA drives in bays. |
|17 | **Install GPU** | Graphics card | Insert into PCIe slot, secure, connect power cables. |
|18 | **Connect Power Cables** | Power all components | PSU to motherboard (24‑pin + 8‑pin), GPU, storage, case fans. |
|19 | **Connect Case Front Panel** | USB, audio, power button | Refer to motherboard manual for pin layout. |
|20 | **Cable Management** | Airflow & aesthetics | Tidy cables, use Velcro ties, leave gaps for airflow. |
|21 | **First Boot & BIOS Setup** | Verify hardware | Enter BIOS (Del/F2), check CPU, RAM, storage detection. |
|22 | **Install Operating System** | OS installation | USB flash drive with Windows 10/11 or Linux; follow on‑screen prompts. |
|23 | **Install Drivers & Updates** | Optimal performance | GPU drivers, chipset, motherboard, Wi‑Fi, etc. |
|24 | **Test & Benchmark** | Ensure stability | Run stress tests (Prime95, 3DMark) and monitor temperatures. |
|25 | **Enjoy & Maintain** | Keep system healthy | Clean dust, update drivers, monitor temperatures. |

---

#### Quick Checklist

- **Case** ✔️
- **PSU** ✔️
- **Motherboard** ✔️
- **CPU** ✔️
- **RAM** ✔️
- **Storage** ✔️
- **GPU** ✔️
- **Cooling** ✔️
- **Cables** ✔️
- **OS** ✔️

#### Common Pitfalls & Fixes

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| **Short circuit** | Double‑check standoffs, avoid touching metal contacts. |
| **No boot** | Verify CPU socket, RAM seating, GPU power. |
| **Overheating** | Ensure proper airflow, reapply thermal paste. |
| **Fan noise** | Check fan direction, replace if defective. |

#### Resources

- **PCPartPicker** – Build planner, price comparison, compatibility checker.  
- **YouTube** – “How to Build a PC” series (e.g., Linus Tech Tips, JayzTwoCents).  
- **Reddit** – r/buildapc for community help.  

Happy building! If you need help choosing specific parts or have questions about a particular step, just let me know.
